name: Hibiki Karin
source:
She's a freshman at the Aoba International University who excels at sports and target practice. As a normal college student, Karin's daily life is full of studying and love. Thanks to her friends and the people around her, she has been able to overcome a tragic past, including the disappearance of her father and the death of her mother. But, her fate suddenly changes, and she must become a sniper.

[edited from [url=http://www.akiba-station.com/blog/?p=2994]Akiba-Station.com[/url]]
